hero.title: Abhidhamma Pitaka: Philosophy and Ethics
hero.description: An analytical exploration of the Abhidhamma Pitaka, the third and most philosophical basket of the Pali Canon, essential for understanding Buddhist metaphysics.

sections.title: 1. Core Study Notes
sections.content:
Core Essence

  • Meta-analysis of Buddhist teachings
  • Focuses on 'Dhamma' (phenomena)
  • Detailed psychological classification

Key Texts

  • Dhammasangani: Categorization of states
  • Kathavatthu: Points of controversy
  • Patthana: Doctrine of causal relations

Structural Mindmap

  • Abhidhamma Pitaka
    • Philosophical methodology
      • Systematic enumeration
      • Categories of consciousness
    • The Seven Books (Sattappakarana)
      • Dhammasangani: Lists of moral/immoral states
      • Vibhanga: Analysis of elements/senses
      • Dhatukatha: Relation of elements
      • Puggalapannatti: Classification of individuals
      • Kathavatthu: Disputes (Moggaliputta Tissa)
      • Yamaka: Pairs of logical puzzles
      • Patthana: 24 conditions of causality

cards.details: First Buddhist Council at Rajgriha; oral recitation of Sutta and Vinaya Pitakas.
Third Buddhist Council at Pataliputra under Ashoka; Abhidhamma Pitaka formally included as the third basket.

traps.title: UPSC Common Exam Traps
items: Confusing Abhidhamma (metaphysical analysis) with Sutta Pitaka (discourses of Buddha).
Assuming the Abhidhamma was compiled during Buddha's lifetime; it was a later systematic development.
Thinking all schools of Buddhism accept the Abhidhamma; it is specific to the Theravada tradition.
